notes: TenantKeep Posture for SharePoint: the optional second sign-in for the SharePoint admin read (Get-PnPTenant, Get-PnPTenantSite, restricted search). Public client, delegated only, no credentials, owned by Kainor LLC. Never consented organisation-wide: a customer's Global Administrator grants it to named admins with deploy/setup/Grant-PostureSharePointAccess.ps1, which also requires assignment, so nobody else can sign in to it. Every SharePoint call goes through one function that accepts Get-PnP commands only.
